component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
' m.inTask is true only in the task thread's m; the render thread keeps a clone where it is false. sub init() m.top.functionName = "work" m.inTask = false m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("fromRender", m.port) end sub
sub onFromRender(event as object) print "ONCHANGE fromRender=" + event.getData().toStr() + " inTask=" + m.inTask.toStr() + " port=" + type(m.port) end sub
sub onFromTask(event as object) print "ONCHANGE fromTask=" + event.getData().toStr() + " inTask=" + m.inTask.toStr() + " port=" + type(m.port) end sub
sub work() m.inTask = true m.top.ready = true msg = wait(2000, m.port) print "TASK got port event: " + type(msg) m.top.fromTask = 7 wait(300, m.port) m.top.report = "done" end sub
